metadata.description: aidd: the toolkit for AI-Driven Development (AIDD), one loop from intent to production with change control at its core: agents do the work, and humans decide what ships. A skill, an MCP server, agent hooks, and an optional delivery team of agent roles.

plugins.name: aidd
plugins.description: AIDD, one loop from intent to production with change control at its core: one skill, the aidd verifier as MCP tools, a guard hook, and session hooks.

plugins.name: aidd-team
plugins.description: Optional: run the aidd loop as a delivery team of agent roles, each applying its discipline's industry standards, with a domain pack per domain and practice skills per kind of work, every standard carrying a checked date (or a reviewed date for a practice), and an edition and source where the document has one. Ships one command per team flow, from onboarding a repository, writing a proposal, or building an MVP, to a quick fix, shipping, and the retrospective. Needs the aidd plugin.

plugins.name: aidd-mods
plugins.description: Optional, experimental: /aidd status, approve, ship, update, and install, answered in Claude Code with no model turn. /aidd status opens a side pane with your next decision, the shape of the work, this branch's work, the flow, and the autopilot run. Type "approve SPEC-1" and it is approved, without a terminal. Nothing it draws reaches the model. Needs Claude Code 2.1.295 or later and the aidd plugin.
